sentences.text: The teeth were subequal, meaning they were roughly the same size, with the gap between them increasing toward the back of the mouth.
An outline of the head preserved in the sediment showed a dorsal inclination, suggesting the animal held its head at an angle.
Yixianopterus is a pterosaur genus found in the Lower Cretaceous Yixian Formation of Liaoning, China.

The genus is known from a single holotype specimen, JZMP-V-12, which was discovered in the uppermost layer of the Yixian Formation known as the Jinggangshan bedding and is now housed at the Benxi Geological Museum.
The deltopectoral crest of the upper humerus extended 25.38 mm, and Metatarsal III measures 28.19 mm in length, while the preserved portion of the tibia is 102.63 mm long.
Lü et al. (2006) assigned Yixianopterus to the family Lonchodectidae based on dental characters and bone ratio comparisons.
Martill (2011) considered it potentially related to Unwindia, while Witton (2013) assigned it to the family Ornithocheiridae.
A reappraisal by Jiang et al. (2020) recovered Yixianopterus as a basal member of the clade Istiodactyliformes.
Yixianopterus lived from the Barremian to the Aptian, between 125.77 and 119.57 million years ago.
Associated organisms indicate the environment was marine with significant volcanic activity.
